## Becoming a Great Designer

> [!quote] 2026-10-23
> for now just consider that you need to be aware of all the changes you’re making, all the new things you’re adding, and all the rearranging that goes into finding the right interface. Those unconscious choices hold the key to explaining your designs to other people and ensuring that your expert perspective remains at the center of the final decision process.
